integrity: Exact Fourier and Poisson-moment identities with an analytic one-sign-change positivity proof; finite checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the stated one-parameter logarithmic radial family, harmonic Poisson-trace energies, and normalized Haar/area conventions. Possible equivalent coverage under Lévy-symbol or generalized Bernstein-function terminology remains a publication-priority risk.
title: A positive logarithmic Douglas jump family beyond superharmonic disk weights
